card.name: Unit of measure ending a dose amount
card.fires_on: The unit word or closing bracket right after a dose number in dosing instructions, such as mg, g, minutes or times. It fires where a frequency or schedule phrase is expected next.

modes.label: Dose units
modes.description: The unit mg or g right after a number in a dose or dose-reduction statement.

card.plain: It marks the end of a dose or time amount, just before the label says how often to give it.
